The balance sheet shows solid capitalization, with shareholders’ equity of $36.0B against $86.8B of assets and substantial retained earnings, which supports credit quality. However, liquidity is a bit tight (current ratio 0.94) and operating earnings are modest relative to the size of the balance sheet and liability load, pointing to only moderate debt-service capacity rather than strong upper-tier investment-grade strength.

DECISION: BBB
